curation.notes: Ultrafast force-clamp (UFFC) spectroscopy in a custom dual-trap optical tweezers: a microtubule dumbbell held between two trapped beads is oscillated over a pedestal bead coated with human Ndc80 complex (Bonsai, Broccoli, Bronsai and mutants), measuring force-dependent bidirectional sliding (catch vs slip behavior). Kinesin/dynein pedestals were used only to determine microtubule polarity.

evidence.snippet: Assembly of the microtubule dumbbells All experiments were performed at 32°C.

acquisition_rate.note: bead coordinates collected every 15 µs; pedestal QPD sampled separately at 1 kHz

evidence.snippet: Dumbbell beads’ coordinates were collected every 15 μs, and force acting on each dumbbell bead was updated every 30 μs; the estimated response time of our system was ~60 μs (34).
a beam of the 1064-nm laser (IPG Photonics, YLR-10-1064-LP) was passed through an AOD (IntraAction Corp., DTD-274HA6 2-AXIS) and spilt into two separate beams via a polarizing beam-splitter cube.
The stiffnesses of optical traps ranged from 0.045 to 0.1 pN/nm, with two traps having nearly identical stiffness.

bead_size.note: trapped dumbbell beads; pedestal beads 1.87 µm

evidence.snippet: In the first method, 0.54-μm-diameter streptavidin-coated polystyrene beads (Spherotech, catalog no. SVP-05-10) were incubated with biotinylated anti-sheep antibodies

bead_functionalization: pedestal: streptavidin + SNAP-GBP or biotinylated anti-GFP

evidence.snippet: Mutant Ndc80c Bonsai proteins (ΔTail with a deletion of 80 amino acids at the N terminus of Hec1 chain, Hec1 K166D, and 3D Nuf2 containing K33D, K41D, and K115D substitutions in the Nuf2 subunit)
Human Ndc80c Bonsai Ndc80-GFP, referred to as WT, was purified as in (32) and human “Broccoli” Ndc80-GFP as in (63).

entities.name: Taxol-stabilized microtubule (bovine brain tubulin, DIG/rhodamine labeled)

evidence.snippet: Microtubules were polymerized using a mixture of bovine tubulins: unlabeled (7.1 mg/ml), DIG-labeled (0.9 mg/ml), and rhodamine-labeled (0.3 mg/ml).
Human kinesin-1 K560-GFP protein with the C-terminal 6-His tag was attached via biotinylated anti-His antibody
the beads were incubated with dynein purified from cow brain (provided by E. Holzbaur)

solution.oxygen_scavenging: glucose oxidase (0.1 mg/ml), catalase (20 µg/ml), glucose
